class.name: RadioServer
class.brief_description: The radio ether: what a radio transmits, every other radio within reach hears.
class.description: A radio is registered here, a transmitter and a receiver at once - a vehicle's ([method radio_set_vehicle]: its position is the vehicle's at the moment of a transmission) or one standing at a place ([method radio_set_position]). Whether it is on is its owner's to answer: it sends only when it can and plays only what it can hear, so one switched on mid-message hears the rest. Whoever transmits has a radio. A transmission goes to every other radio within its reach, whatever it is tuned to: the receiver compares the channel itself, so a message tuned to midway is still heard (TTrain::radio_message(), Train.cpp:11010-11029).

method.name: radio_create
method.description: A new radio, at no place and hearing nothing until it is told.

method.name: radio_free
method.description: The radio switched off: it neither hears nor transmits any more.

method.name: radio_set_position
method.description: A radio standing at a place.

method.name: radio_set_receive_callback
method.description: What the radio does with what it hears: [code]callback(kind: Kind, channel: int, payload: Variant, position: Vector3)[/code]. A radio without one only transmits.

method.name: radio_set_vehicle
method.description: A radio in a vehicle of any kind, wherever the vehicle is ([method VehicleServer.vehicle_get_position]).

method.name: radio_transmit
method.description: From where the radio is, on [param channel], to every other radio within [param reach] metres - everywhere when it is not positive. [param payload] is what [param kind] carries: [code]{sound: SfxEvent, transcript: Transcript}[/code] for a message, a [enum RailVehicleRadio.RadioCall] for a call, nothing for Radio-Stop.

signal.name: transmitted
signal.description: Something was transmitted - for whoever follows the ether without being a radio, such as the scenario.

constants.constant: A radio call to the dispatcher.
Radio-Stop: every driven train within reach brakes in emergency.
